name: How many pages can go on one sheet?

acceptedAnswer.text: 2, 4, 6, 9 or 16. The tool picks the paper orientation and grid that make the pages largest; you can also set portrait or landscape yourself.

name: Can I put invoices two to an A4 page at their real size?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — choose Invoices on A4. Each invoice keeps its own size (it is never enlarged), two or four go on a sheet, and an optional 30 mm binding margin leaves room for punching or gluing.

name: Can I combine several PDF files?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Add several PDFs — their pages follow one another in the order of the file list, then are laid out on sheets.

name: Does it work for Arabic, Persian or Hebrew documents?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Right to left places page 1 in the top-right cell, the reading order of those documents.

name: Are links and filled-in form fields kept?

acceptedAnswer.text: Everything you see is kept: text, images, filled-in form values, stamps, seals and comments are drawn onto the sheet exactly where they were. The result is flat, though: links are no longer clickable and form fields can no longer be edited, so fill in a form before putting it on a sheet.
